name: Leo Appleby
source:
Head of the vampire family. Aloof and mysterious. Leo has the strong resolve required to lead his family and he can never show weakness to anyone, yet he slowly shows changes as he becomes more intimate with you...!?

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.vampirekaigai=en]Google Play[/url]]
